BiblicalUsage: Shimeah is the son of Mikloth. He is named among the Benjamites who dwell at Jerusalem, in the genealogy the Chronicler gives twice.
TheologicalSignificance: Dwelling at Jerusalem is a homecoming, and Shimeah's place in the list is his testimony.
